plan: My private value is $30. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. Bidding above true value risks losing money if I win, while bidding below risks not winning a potentially profitable item. Since the third-highest bid determines my payment, bidding $30 allows me to maximize potential profit while minimizing downside risk. I'll aim to capture the item if my valuation is competitive.

This strategy ensures I only win when the payment is less than my value, protecting my potential earnings.
